fields.value: Annotated reference dataset for benchmarking object detection algorithms

dsDescriptionValue.value:
Annotated dataset with 2002 high-resolution images of wildflowers (patches of approximately 1m2) taken in 5 landscape types (roadsides, urban area’s, cropland, grassland, and marshland) around and in the city of Eindhoven, The Netherlands.
The dataset contains over 65K bounding box annotations and holds 160 flowering plant species. Annotations are created with a strict protocol.

The dataset can be used to develop AI (computer vision) algorithms that can count and identify wildflowers. It can also be used as a reference dataset to benchmark object detection algorithms

value: High resolution photos (jpg files). Bounding box annotations in Pascal VOC standard (xml files).
